description: This file defines an abstract class 'View' within the SuiteCRM Search UI MVC namespace. The class manages a Sugar_Smarty template object and provides methods for construction, rendering, and template file management.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class for rendering templates using Sugar_Smarty in the SuiteCRM Search UI MVC framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the View with a specified template file and creates a new Sugar_Smarty instance.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the Sugar_Smarty instance used for rendering.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: A hook for derived classes to assign variables to templates before display; empty by default.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the assigned template using the Sugar_Smarty instance.

methods.name: getTemplateFile
methods.description: Returns the current template file path.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets a new template file path.
